endpoints.description: Score financial news sentiment by ticker and sector with bullish/bearish themes and market-moving probability
Extract all stock tickers, companies, indices, and macro entities mentioned in news articles
Score the potential market impact of a news article with price direction, magnitude, and trade signal
Detect significant financial events, M&A activity, regulatory actions, and breaking developments
Identify trending financial themes, dominant narratives, and sector-level sentiment shifts
Compare sentiment and coverage across news sources to identify consensus and contrarian signals
Validate news input readiness and recommend the best analysis endpoint
ONE-CALL: full news intelligence — sentiment, tickers, events, trends, and trading signals
